description: This file defines the HeadersMetadataStrategy class which implements MetadataStrategyInterface for handling metadata headers in AWS S3 client encryption workflows. It provides methods to save metadata from an envelope into request arguments and to load metadata from an S3 object into an envelope.

classes.name: HeadersMetadataStrategy
classes.description: A class that manages the serialization and deserialization of encryption metadata headers to and from S3 objects.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Stores encryption-related metadata from the MetadataEnvelope into the request parameters for S3 PutObject.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Creates a MetadataEnvelope object populated with relevant metadata headers extracted from S3 object response arguments.
